record.one_liner: HubSpot is a CRM platform with marketing, sales, service, content and commerce hubs, plus a developer platform for building integrations.
record.auth_notes: Fetched auth doc lists: OAuth (Bearer access token per installed account, for multi-account/Marketplace apps); static auth (single-account app with a static access token, the successor to private apps); service keys (scoped Bearer keys); client-credentials tokens (webhooks journal API only). Developer API keys (hapikey query param) are not a general API auth method and apply only to certain app features.
record.access_notes: Developer test accounts are free (90-day trial of many enterprise features; they expire unless API calls are made, and can be renewed). Standard accounts can be free or paid. I did not find a fetched page that states whether a free standard account has full API access, so that is unconfirmed. Some endpoints and features need paid hubs (e.g. custom pipelines are not on free tools; MCP quotes and AEO tools need Professional/Enterprise).
record.blocker: Plan-tier limits on some features, and a multi-account integration needs an OAuth backend (and a Marketplace listing if distributed there). Rate limits and free-account API scope were not verified. Date-based API versioning (e.g. 2026-09) requires tracking versions.
